comment: Third-party material Cmdr ships as files that no lockfile knows about: icon sets, fonts, code snippets copied in. Vendoring one? Credit it here in the same commit. `pnpm check third-party-notices` validates this list and merges it into THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md and the Acknowledgements dialog. Fields and rules: scripts/check/checks/DETAILS.md § Vendored credits.

credits.name: Material Design Icons
credits.author: Pictogrammers
credits.changes: The `mdi:dropbox` icon, filled with Dropbox blue (`#0061fe`) and given an attribution comment.

credits.name: Material Symbols
credits.author: Google
credits.changes: The `material-symbols:android` icon, filled with Android green (`#3ddc84`) and given an attribution comment.

credits.name: selfh.st icons
credits.author: selfh.st
credits.changes: Colors and shapes are as published. Both files gained an attribution comment and were re-serialized for macOS's SVG renderer (inline `style` fills written as `fill` attributes, path data and gradient ids in an equivalent form).
